detail.longDescription: OpenAI rolled out ChatGPT Wallet in November 2026, allowing ChatGPT Pro and higher-tier subscribers to browse merchants and complete purchases through Dots, ChatGPT's built-in AI agent. The launch comes just months after OpenAI pulled the plug on its earlier Instant Checkout feature in March 2026, underscoring how rapidly the agentic commerce landscape has shifted.
